overview:
TX-30 is an open seat in Dallas that became more Democratic after redistricting, with a partisan lean of about 25 points toward the party. No incumbent is on the ballot and no general-election polls are available, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals, candidate resources, and market pricing, all of which point in the same direction.

Democrat Frederick Haynes has raised roughly $695,000 and benefits from about $200,000 in outside support, while Republican Everett Jackson has raised about $25,000 with only a few thousand dollars on hand. Prediction markets put the Democratic chance near 97 percent. The expected margin is about 26 points, in line with the district's fundamentals, and the seat is rated Safe Democratic.
